summary: A place to choose files or drop them, around a native file input.

disabled.description: No file can be chosen or dropped. The component disables its input.

root.note: A frame with a dashed boundary around the input and any hint the author writes. Files dropped on it go to the input.

input.note: A native file input the author writes and marks with data-part="input" (D14). It carries the files under its own name; its button is painted as a button of the kit.

events.input: The input's own event, also dispatched on it after a drop.
events.change: The input's own event, also dispatched on it after a drop.

guidance.text: The author names the input with a label, aria-label or aria-labelledby, or puts the field in a form field.
A drop keeps only what the input would take: one file without `multiple`, and the kinds its `accept` names.

notYet: A list of the chosen files with a way to remove one.
